'''Episode VII''' is an [[Icons|era icon]]. Cards associated with the sequel-trilogy era of the ''Star Wars'' films usually carry it, and cards associated with the prequel era usually carry the [[Episode I]] icon. Cards without an era icon usually represent the original-trilogy era. No rules attach to era icons themselves, but like any icon they can be referenced by other cards.<ref name="ar">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 9, "Icons - Era Icons".</ref>
